story here.

Find your program

Degrees in hand, ready to contribute

‘It was McGill that supported me’

NFL Super Bowl champion and Medicine grad, now finished his residency, expresses gratitude and talks about what comes next.

At home in the ‘land of opportunity’

Master’s student from Scotland came to McGill to work on metal fuels with a world-renowned professor, then co-founded a company with him.

Turning ideas into action for communities

Recent graduates win $50,000 Pathy Fellowships that allow them to work on initiatives designed for lasting impact.
